Plasma.et: From Late Latin plasma (literally “mold”), from Ancient Greek πλάσμα (plásma, “something formed”).

Plastik.et: Borrowed from English plastic (“malleable, flexible”). Compare Hunsrik Plasdik.
Borrowed from French plastique, from Latin plasticus (“of molding”), from Ancient Greek πλαστικός (plastikós), from πλάσσειν (plássein, “to mold, form”).

Plaste.et: From Thermoplaste, plural of Thermoplast (“thermoplastic”), originally a tradename used by Buna Werke Schkopau.
